final.headline: Match one price, ask one vendor for protection, flag one parity breach; leave the one-day blip and the slow slide alone.
final.narrative:
Match: Oatmeal Pet Shampoo 250 ml has been 9.0% under our price on MarketB for 6 days. Matching at ₹292 keeps the margin at 34.9%, above the 30.0% floor, and earns ₹2,357 more over the horizon than holding.

Ask the vendor: Chicken & Rice Adult 3 kg has been 6.9% under our price on MarketA for 9 days. Matching would take the margin to 15.5%, under the 20.0% floor, so we ask Barkley & Co for price protection of ₹41 a unit instead of cutting alone.

Breach: Litterly sells Clumping Bentonite Unscented 10 kg at ₹566 on MarketB, 12.0% under our price for 9 days and under the ₹624 minimum advertised price. We do not follow it down; the message asks for parity.

Leave alone: Training Bites 60 g dipped 13.9% under us on MarketC for a single day. Matching that blip would have cost ₹2,987 of margin for nothing, so we hold and re-check tomorrow. A competitor price on Squeaky Plush Duck is falling 0.73 points a day but has not crossed the undercut threshold; we watch it.
